note: Adapted from Sjöstedt's (1900) description of the species, the original in German; the alate is recorded as unknown in the original, and no nymph is described. The diagnostic characters are the original comparison with Eutermes baculi; locality and collecting records are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier very close to that of Eutermes baculi but smaller and with a smaller frontal elevation; the anterior margin of the pronotum is not concave at the middle, whereas in the latter it is concave there.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Body white, extended flat, almost uniform in width and about as wide as the head; head rectangular, angles rounded, pale red-yellow, almost completely smooth and shining; above the frons a small setose elevation, from which a pale fine ridge runs to the back of the head. Mandibles rod-like, slender, outer margin almost straight, slightly concave inwards at the middle, inner margin also slightly concave at the middle; outwards the mandibles become slightly thicker again and then thinner, ending in a short, inwardly curved point; in lateral view the mandibles are distinctly arched downwards and only slightly shorter than the head. Labrum rectangular, with a fine prolongation at each of the two anterior angles. Antennae 14-segmented, white, becoming pale red-yellow ringed towards the apex, slightly longer than the mandibles. Pilosity of the thorax less dense than that of the abdomen; pronotum oval, slightly narrowed laterally, anterior and posterior lobes about equal in size, neither lobe notched. Total length 5.2, head with mandibles 2.6.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Body very narrow, less than 3 in length; head width 0.7, with a very distinct small fontanelle pit at the middle; first tooth of the right mandible distinctly larger than the second, first and second teeth of the left mandible equal in size; antennae 13-segmented, segments 3 and 4 small and ring-like; body white, head tinged with pale yellow; anterior margin of the pronotum not concave at the middle.
